name: dshpilot
description: DSHPilot — Desktop Workstation for DeepSeek Harness

scripts.build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run build:web && pnpm run build:remote-pwa
scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @dshpilot/control-contracts build && pnpm --filter @dshpilot/desktop-host build && pnpm --filter @dshpilot/dsh-plugin-desktop build && pnpm --filter @dshpilot/dsh-client-desktop build && pnpm --filter @dshpilot/remote-daemon build && pnpm --filter @dshpilot/remote-client build && pnpm --filter @dshpilot/remote-relay build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @dshpilot/control-contracts typecheck && pnpm --filter @dshpilot/desktop-host typecheck && pnpm --filter @dshpilot/dsh-plugin-desktop typecheck && pnpm --filter @dshpilot/dsh-client-desktop typecheck && pnpm --filter @dshpilot/remote-daemon typecheck && pnpm --filter @dshpilot/remote-client typecheck && pnpm --filter @dshpilot/remote-relay typecheck && pnpm --filter @dshpilot/remote-pwa exec tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm --filter @dshpilot/desktop typecheck && pnpm run typecheck:scripts
